scope: Curated two-act gallery, four independent artwork pages, material studies and same-scene editions. Crossover has overprinted and lifted proofs; garden has quieter framing and reduced peripheral density; rain has a concentrated light mass, silver fringe and lower coda.
presentation: Yesterday, Today: a translucent time specimen with lilac cellophane replacing the corrugated hose, unequal pink hydrangea clusters, pearl contact sheets and feather veils. Outer Chinese title and text-free inner memory lens retained. All four scenes keep native navigation, static mode and single-canvas immersive viewing.
images: Three revised artworks each have a 1600px cover, three independent 1200px material-camera studies, profile, verso, 1600x2000 print and reloaded GLB. Per-work build.json and responsive manifest hold exact hashes.
modelLimitations: GLB omits web lighting, bloom, rain animation and interaction. Garden is a static snapshot; its mineral ground uses authored vertex colours rather than the browser-only grain shader.
navigation: Unchanged four-world order, native picker and contextual gallery return
